title_sq: Te Rruga Margarita Tutulani , Shitet Super Apartament 1+1, I Sapo Investuar!!!
description_sq: Te Rruga Margarita Tutulani ,prane Shkolles Deshmoret e Lirise, Shitet Super Apartament 1+1, I Sapo Investuar!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 5 (te fundit) te nje pallati ekzistues, si dhe ka nje siperfaqe neto prej 62 m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, dhoma e gjumit, tualeti dhe ballkoni. Apartamenti eshte i sapo investuar, me instalime elektrike/hidraulike te reja, vetrata dopioxham. Aktualisht jane duke u vene dyer te reja. Prona ka dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Orientimi i prones eshte Jug-Lindje. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje nder zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes si dhe ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: On Margarita Tutulani Street, Super Apartment 1+1 for sale, Newly Invested!!!
description_en: On Margarita Tutulani Street, near the Martyrs of Freedom School, Super Apartment 1+1 for sale, Newly Invested!!! The property is located on the 5th (top) floor of an existing building, and has a net area of ​​62 m2. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen corner, the bedroom, the toilet and the balcony. The apartment is newly invested, with new electrical/hydraulic installations, double-glazed windows. New doors are currently being installed. The property has regular mortgage documentation. The orientation of the property is South-East. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana and offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
